title: JetBrains Air – Multitask with agents
description: JetBrains Air is a bold, futuristic product page for JetBrains' AI coding agent. The design departs dramatically from traditional JetBrains branding — using a dark, space-themed aesthetic with neon purple, cyan, and magenta gradient overlays. The hero uses a massive animated headline with particle effects and a floating 3D interface mockup. Feature sections use glassmorphism cards with backdrop blur and gradient borders. AI agent capabilities are shown through interactive code snippet demonstrations. The design communicates cutting-edge AI technology through its visual language — bright neon gradients, transparency layers, animated particle systems, and cyberpunk-inspired UI elements. The color palette is deep midnight with vibrant purple primary (#7C3AED) and cyan secondary accents. This is an unusually bold design for JetBrains (known for more conservative design) and signals a deliberate shift toward a more futuristic brand identity for their AI products.
primary_use_case: Great reference for AI coding tools, developer products, and established brands launching AI features that want a futuristic, neon-heavy design departure from their main brand.
style_vibe: Futuristic, cyberpunk-inspired AI product page with neon gradients, glassmorphism, particle effects, and a bold departure from traditional brand design.
